convert_object_to_chunk: convert any Python object to an ActionEngine Chunk using to_chunk with an optional mimetype
deserialize_chunk_to_bytes: deserialize an ActionEngine Chunk back to bytes using from_chunk with an optional mimetype
serialize_object_to_bytes: serialize any Python object to raw bytes using to_bytes with an optional mimetype and registry
convert_pil_image_to_png_bytes: convert a PIL Image to PNG file bytes using pil_image_to_png_file_bytes
convert_dict_to_json_bytes: convert a Python dictionary to JSON-encoded bytes using dict_to_bytes
